hero.title: Executive Councils
hero.intro: Standing groups that hold their membership across the year, so that the work compounds rather than beginning again at each meeting.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.lead: A council exists to think properly about one field, over a long enough period that the thinking gets somewhere.
purpose.body: Where a forum convenes around a single question and closes, a council holds its membership across the year. Each session begins where the last ended. The result is less immediate than a forum and considerably more durable.

councils.title: The Councils
councils.intro: Councils form around whatever the members have genuinely in common — an industry, a region, or a remit.

items.name: Sector Councils
items.body: Organised by industry, for questions that only make sense with shared commercial context. Members arrive already fluent in the same landscape.

items.name: Regional Councils
items.body: Organised by geography, where the operating environment is the common ground and regulation is a shared concern rather than a footnote.

items.name: Practice Councils
items.body: Organised by function, drawing members who hold a comparable remit across different industries.

format.title: Meeting Format
format.intro: Every council runs to the same shape, whatever it is organised around.

steps.title: Convene
steps.body: Each council opens with the questions its members are carrying, gathered before the session rather than raised in it.

steps.title: Work the question
steps.body: One subject is taken at a time and worked properly. Councils would rather finish one question than open four.

steps.title: Record the position
steps.body: What the council concludes is written down for its own members, so the next session starts from it.

steps.title: Carry it between sessions
steps.body: Work continues in the interval. The council is a standing group, not a series of unrelated meetings.

benefits.title: Benefits
benefits.intro: What a standing group offers that a one-off gathering cannot.

features.label: Continuity
features.body: The same people, across a year. Context accumulates instead of resetting at each gathering.

features.label: Depth
features.body: One question at a time, taken further than a single meeting would allow.

features.label: Record
features.body: Positions are written down and held for the council's own members.

features.label: Reach
features.body: Councils extend a member's context beyond their own market and function.

calendar.title: Annual Calendar
calendar.intro: The shape of a council year. Specific dates are set with each council and are not published here.

steps.title: Opening session
steps.body: The council sets its agenda for the year and agrees what it intends to resolve.

steps.title: Working sessions
steps.body: The substance of the year. Each session takes one question and closes it as far as it can be closed.

steps.title: Between sessions
steps.body: Members circulate material and carry the work forward, so nothing restarts from the beginning.

steps.title: Closing session
steps.body: The council reviews what it concluded, and hands forward what it did not.

advisors.title: Expert Advisors
advisors.placeholderNote: Advisors are named individuals — this section stays a placeholder until there are real people, with their agreement, to name.
